'''GolanGear''' was the athletics division of weapons manufacturer [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]].<ref name="blog">{{Blog|caledre25|23|Endnotes For Fists Of Ion: Memoirs Of A Champion Shockboxer by Lobar Aybock, Chapter VII: Hard Raine}}</ref> The department produced [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxing]] equipment, including the suit worn by champion shockboxer [[Lobar Aybock]].<ref name="Fists of Ion">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20081031.html|text="Fists of Ion"|int=Fists of Ion|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>
